us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Americans mark the 25th anniversary of the Sept. 11 attacks
bullets: Memorial ceremonies were held in New York, at the Pentagon, and in Pennsylvania.
Nearly 3,000 people killed in the 2001 attacks were remembered by families and officials.
President Donald Trump attended the Pentagon ceremony with first lady Melania Trump.

articles.title: AP review finds DOJ struggled to win felony assault cases against protesters
bullets: AP analyzed 102 protesters arrested in four major cities on federal assault charges.
The Justice Department failed to secure felony convictions in most of the cases reviewed.
A dozen trials ended in acquittal, mistrial, or dismissal.

articles.title: Minnesota churches face court fights over ICE surveillance and protest rights
bullets: Twin Cities churches are involved in cases tied to immigration enforcement and protests.
One Minneapolis church asked a court to reprimand the government over surveillance of protest activity.
More than three dozen protesters are seeking dismissal of charges from a St. Paul church disruption.

articles.title: Federal court rejects Trump administration order keeping Michigan coal plant open
bullets: A federal appeals court said the Energy Department exceeded its authority.
The order had forced the J.H. Campbell coal plant to operate past its planned retirement.
Michigan, Illinois, Minnesota, and environmental groups had challenged the federal action.

articles.title: Judge keeps Arizona sheriff’s office under supervision in racial profiling case
bullets: A federal judge rejected Maricopa County’s bid to end court supervision.
The case stems from immigration crackdowns under former Sheriff Joe Arpaio.
The judge said the county had not shown a durable remedy against future violations.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: BRICS leaders voice concern over Middle East tensions at New Delhi summit
bullets: BRICS leaders met in New Delhi as wars in the Middle East and Ukraine strained the bloc.
The group expressed concern over rising Middle East tensions.
Leaders also condemned sanctions not authorized by the United Nations.

articles.title: Russian strikes kill three in Ukraine as Putin warns Europe on troop deployments
bullets: Russian strikes killed three people in Ukraine, according to AP’s report.
Vladimir Putin warned European governments against sending troops to Ukraine.
The comments came around the BRICS summit in India.

articles.title: Iraq moves to contain fallout after Saudi pipeline attack linked to Iraqi territory
bullets: Iraq said attacks on a Saudi pipeline originated from Iraqi territory.
The incident heightened regional tensions tied to Iran-backed militias and Houthi activity.
Iraq closed two border crossings with Iran as authorities investigated.

articles.title: Brazil’s Flávio Bolsonaro faces corruption investigation before election
bullets: Brazil’s top court unsealed documents tied to a corruption investigation.
Prosecutors are examining funds for a film about former President Jair Bolsonaro.
The probe comes weeks before Brazil’s presidential election first round.

articles.title: China’s Xi arrives in Delhi for BRICS summit and Modi talks
bullets: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in New Delhi for the BRICS summit.
The Reuters report said Xi was also expected to hold talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
The summit is taking place amid tensions from the Iran and Ukraine wars.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Modi urges BRICS to make Global South a ‘rule-shaper’
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the opening session of the BRICS summit in New Delhi.
He called for dismantling a global ‘pyramid of privilege’.
Modi said BRICS should move forward through consensus and practical cooperation.

articles.title: Vande Bharat freight train begins Ahmedabad–Mumbai trial run
bullets: India’s first Vande Bharat freight EMU began trials on Western Railway.
The trial is being conducted between Ahmedabad and Mumbai Central.
The 16-coach train is designed for high-speed parcel and goods movement.

articles.title: Modi meets Abu Dhabi Crown Prince on India-UAE ties and West Asia
bullets: Modi met Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan on the BRICS sidelines.
The leaders discussed defence, AI, space, critical minerals, energy, food security, and connectivity.
The UAE’s International Holding Company announced an $11.5 billion aluminium project in Odisha.

articles.title: Kashmiri Pandit employees seek Amit Shah’s intervention over threats
bullets: Kashmiri Pandit employees working in the Valley wrote to Union Home Minister Amit Shah.
They cited recent threat letters, some containing names, addresses, and phone numbers.
The employees asked for investigations, stronger security, and a security audit of settlements.

articles.title: Madhya Pradesh High Court refuses to quash Damoh school hijab-row case
bullets: The High Court declined to end criminal proceedings against four accused.
The court said wearing hijab alone is not an offence under the MP Freedom of Religion Act.
It said allegations involving coercion and compulsory practices must be tested at trial.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top US market movers from the latest trading session

articles.title: HPE jumps more than 12% on AI infrastructure demand focus
bullets: Hewlett Packard Enterprise closed at $62.09, up 12.43%.
Investors focused on AI systems, networking, and hybrid-cloud demand.
Trading volume was reported well above its three-month average.

articles.title: Dell surges nearly 12% as analysts highlight AI infrastructure cycle
bullets: Dell shares closed near $567.30, up about 12%.
RBC Capital Markets initiated coverage with an outperform rating.
The report cited Dell’s position in the multiyear AI infrastructure spending cycle.

articles.title: Oracle swings lower after early AI-cloud earnings boost
bullets: Oracle reported fiscal Q1 revenue of $19.3 billion and strong cloud infrastructure growth.
The stock rose premarket after results, then finished down about 1.7%.
Analysts focused on margin pressure and the path to cash-flow recovery.

articles.title: Adobe gains despite cautious guidance after Q3 results
bullets: Adobe reported Q3 revenue of $6.76 billion, above analyst estimates cited by Yahoo Finance.
The stock ended higher after earlier premarket weakness.
Investors weighed results against a fourth-quarter revenue outlook viewed as cautious.

articles.title: Nvidia remains one of the most active AI names as tech stocks rally
bullets: Nvidia traded near flat in the latest session after heavy volume.
Tech and semiconductor ETFs rose as investors returned to AI-linked stocks.
Nvidia remained a key focus in reports on AI infrastructure spending.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Top corporate and business stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: McClatchy cuts hit Miami Herald and other newspapers
bullets: McClatchy made deep staff cuts across multiple newspapers it owns.
The Miami Herald was among the affected outlets.
The company cited changing audience behavior, market dynamics, and technology shifts.

articles.title: Oracle beats estimates as AI-cloud demand drives growth
bullets: Oracle’s fiscal Q1 revenue rose to $19.3 billion.
Cloud infrastructure revenue jumped 121% year over year.
The results helped ease concerns about AI-related spending and cash burn.

articles.title: Microsoft plans major data-center expansion to meet AI demand
bullets: Microsoft plans to more than triple its data-center capacity, according to Bloomberg via Yahoo Finance.
The expansion is aimed at easing computing shortages.
The report said limited capacity has forced Microsoft to turn away some AI and cloud business.

articles.title: Adobe reports Q3 beat while investors assess AI and leadership transition
bullets: Adobe reported Q3 revenue ahead of analyst estimates cited by Yahoo Finance.
The company’s AI strategy remained a key investor focus.
Adobe also disclosed a CEO transition plan in recent company filings.

articles.title: Multiconsult and Rejlers announce Nordic consultancy merger of equals
bullets: Multiconsult and Rejlers said their boards adopted a joint merger plan.
The companies aim to create a pan-Nordic multidisciplinary consultancy group.
The announcement was carried by PR Newswire.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Top technology stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Anthropic says Claude users in Houthi-held Yemen sought weapons help
bullets: Anthropic said users in northern Yemen tried to use Claude to develop advanced missiles.
The area is controlled by Iran-backed Houthi rebels.
The report highlighted growing concerns about AI use in warfare.

articles.title: California signs laws targeting risks from social media and AI chatbots
bullets: California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed measures aimed at protecting children online.
The laws address risks tied to social media and AI chatbots.
Anthropic supported separate laws intended to improve oversight of AI companies.

articles.title: Anthropic researcher resigns with warning on AI development risks
bullets: An Anthropic researcher said he was leaving the company over AI safety concerns.
He argued major AI firms are not acting responsibly enough.
The concerns echoed broader warnings about loss of human control over advanced AI.

articles.title: Microsoft plans to triple data-center footprint for AI and cloud demand
bullets: Microsoft plans to expand data-center capacity to address compute shortages.
The company has faced constraints serving AI and cloud customers.
The plan underscores continued investment in AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Nvidia and Palantir launch AI stack for supply-chain operations
bullets: Nvidia and Palantir unveiled a jointly developed AI stack for industrial supply chains.
Nvidia is using the platform as the first customer.
The companies aim to sell the system across industry and government markets.
